verdict.rationale: Glama hosts servers you supply. You connect a GitHub repo and it builds the image, or you ship a Dockerfile, npm package or PyPI module and it can infer build settings. Deployed servers get the Gateway in front automatically with no proxy wiring. However, the evidence only covers deploying code that already implements MCP; nothing shows OpenAPI-to-MCP conversion or a way to wrap custom code so you avoid writing protocol handling. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/API-definition import that generates an MCP server, an SDK or wrapper that removes protocol plumbing for custom code, and independent hands-on corroboration of the hosting flow.
